descriptionHtml:
Bug B24 · P1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC 7–8 ready for qa; TFA-94514 AC 1 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): no 'deleted' toast is AC 8; TC-24/S03 fails on the same evidence; Nursing Home has no trash icon and no screen calls snf.remove (TC-24/S05, dev U09).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S16, TC-01/S17, TC-24/S03, TC-24/S05, TC-24/S28

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S22 Code and doc read: the hand-off doc and field names, and two TFA-94514 behaviours with no code path on main (removing a Nursing Home resident, the end-of-pilot survey)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Engineering prepares a simple hand-off doc so Vikram knows how to access the analytics data (TFA-94514 AC 9)
  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize … (UAT OAT-06 closing line; TFA-94514 AC 8; TFA-94609 AC 5; TFA-94609 AC 6)
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex (UAT OAT-06 Test 6; TFA-94514 AC 6)
  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U2 Removing / discharging a patient is logged, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 2; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U9a Task reminders are also tracked through an end-of-pilot task-reminder survey: the survey exists in the app and its answers are stored (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; TFA-94514 AC 2)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given docs/pilot-analytics.md at e02167f; convex/schema.ts, convex/lib/patientActivity.ts, convex/lib/usage.ts, convex/surveys.ts, aiCallLog in convex/schema.ts; src/routes/snf, src/features/snf and src/data/snf.ts; convex/surveys.ts

When Read the doc as Vikram would; check every table, column and enum value the four behaviours, item 6 and item 7 use against the code; follow every link; search every Nursing Home screen for a control that removes a resident or logs patient_removed with nursing_home; read which survey kinds convex/surveys.ts accepts

Then Every table and field is described in plain words; values are readable (no unlabeled boolean, no internal enum without a meaning); the per-day average is explained; the doc says how to find a physician's rows; every link resolves; the doc is somewhere Vikram has and will keep; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94514 AC 8 / AC 9 + UAT closing line for the doc and fields. Evidence with file and line. Seen in the design read: the doc links docs/patient-activity-analytics.md, which does not exist; PR #86 deletes docs/ (Q9); userId opacity and fn names are Q8. …

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method DOC · Document check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

New, minor: the doc omits aiCallLog ok/parseStatus/httpStatus/promptChars/responseChars/error (schema.ts:226). Pending: Q7 (missing survey vs TFA-94514 AC 2), Q8 (opaque userId and fn names readable for Vikram?), Q9 (PR #86 deletes docs/; where the doc lives), Q4 (what NH removal means).

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa); TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for pr)

New local lane code-review: status failed in code-review/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane wrote no productIssue; counted from its physicianImpact)).

Detail:

This scenario fails. Three of its failing points are recorded gaps, one waits on an open question, and one is new.

What holds: docs/pilot-analytics.md describes pilotUsageEvents, pilotDailyRounding, surveyResponses and the aiCallLog timing fields in plain words, and they match the code. The event names in apps/web/convex/lib/usage.ts, the daily rollup columns, the survey kinds and answer keys, and durationMs/providerMs/fellBackFrom all exist. The doc explains the per-day average (minutesPreRoundToComplete ÷ encountersTimed). It says how to find a physician's rows: filter on userId and day, or run the _recentForActor/_dailyForActor queries, which exist in usage.ts, surveys.ts and patientActivity.ts.

What fails:
1. **Broken link (known:broken-link).** The doc sends readers to docs/patient-activity-analytics.md for the patientActivityEvents fields. That file does not exist; docs/ holds only five files. So removalReason (manual / clear_data / account_deleted), scan_census_completed, promptId and the other patientActivityEvents fields are never explained to Vikram.
2. **aiCallLog fields left out (new).** The doc names only durationMs, providerMs, fn, model and fellBackFrom. aiCallLog also has a bare boolean `ok`, plus parseStatus, httpStatus, promptChars, responseChars and error, and the doc says nothing about them.
3. **No Nursing Home removal (known:no-nh-removal).** The backend deleteSnfResident does log patient_removed with careSetting nursing_home. But useSnfActions().remove at src/data/snf.ts:36 is never called from any screen: the only place useSnfActions is used is AddResident.tsx, which takes just `add`. Only e2e tests call api.snf.remove. What removal should mean there is Q4.
4. **No end-of-pilot survey (known:no-endpilot-survey, pending Q7).** apps/web/convex/surveys.ts:15-19 accepts only baseline, handoff_followup and feedback.

Also pending: whether the userId opacity and fn names in the doc are acceptable is Q8.

Product issue (from physicianImpact): the lane wrote no productIssue; "failed · product" is counted from its physicianImpact (full text below).

Waits on open question (pendingOn):

  • Q7
  • Q8

New findings (newFindings):

  • apps/web/convex/schema.ts:226: parseStatus holds the internal values ok/repaired/failed, and httpStatus, promptChars, responseChars and error are also absent from the doc.

Known gaps confirmed (knownGapsConfirmed):

  • docs/pilot-analytics.md:18: The doc links a field-list doc for patientActivityEvents that is not in the repo; docs/ holds only five files, and patient-activity-analytics.md is not one of them
  • apps/web/convex/lib/patientActivity.ts:38: patientActivityEvents carries removalReason values and a scan_census_completed event that the doc never explains, because it defers to the missing file
  • apps/web/src/data/snf.ts:36: The Nursing Home remove hook exists only in the data layer
  • apps/web/src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx:26: The only Nursing Home screen that uses useSnfActions takes only `add`; no screen under routes/snf or features/snf calls remove
  • apps/web/convex/surveys.ts:15: The survey validator accepts only baseline, handoff_followup and feedback; there is no end-of-pilot task-reminder kind
  • docs/pilot-analytics.md:19: The doc itself admits that whether reminders helped is left to an end-of-pilot survey that the code does not provide
  • docs/pilot-analytics.md:18: The doc points readers to a file for the full patientActivityEvents field list, but that file is not in the repo (docs/ has only five .md files, none of them patient-activity-analytics.md).
  • apps/web/convex/lib/patientActivity.ts:62: patientActivityEvents has fields and values the doc never explains, because their explanation sits behind the broken link: removalReason and its values manual/clear_data/account_deleted, promptId, requestId, selectedCount/createdCount/linkedCount, and the event scan_census_completed.
  • apps/web/src/data/snf.ts:36: The client exposes snf.remove only as a hook, and no screen calls it.
  • apps/web/src/routes/snf/AddResident.tsx:26: The only Nursing Home screen that uses useSnfActions takes just `add`, never `remove`.
  • apps/web/convex/surveys.ts:15: The survey kinds accepted are only baseline, handoff_followup and feedback; there is no end-of-pilot task-reminder survey.
  • docs/pilot-analytics.md:19: The doc itself defers task-reminder usefulness to an end-of-pilot survey that does not exist.

Open questions (openQuestions):

  • Q4: what removal means in Nursing Home (delete vs. take off today's list); the missing screen is still the known gap no-nh-removal.
  • Q7: whether the missing end-of-pilot task-reminder survey stands as a fail against TFA-94514 AC 2.
  • Q8: whether opaque Better Auth userIds and internal fn names (notes.generateNote, …) are acceptable to Vikram.
  • Q9: PR #86 deletes docs/; where the hand-off doc will live for Vikram.
  • Q4: what removal of a Nursing Home resident means (discharge vs delete). The missing screen is still known:no-nh-removal.
  • Q7: whether the missing end-of-pilot task-reminder survey stands as a gap (known:no-endpilot-survey).
  • Q8: whether an opaque Better Auth userId and function names like notes.generateNote are readable enough for Vikram.
  • Q9: PR #86 deletes docs/, so where the hand-off doc will live is undecided.

Not decidable from the code (notDecidableByCode):

  • where Vikram keeps the doc (DOC (a person; PR #86 deletes docs/, Q9))
  • Whether the doc sits somewhere Vikram has and will keep (half:where Vikram keeps the doc, Q9).
  • Whether Vikram finds the wording readable in practice and can reach the Convex dashboard Data tab.
  • Whether the doc is somewhere Vikram has and will keep (a person checks this; Q9).
  • Whether Vikram actually finds the doc's wording plain and usable in the Convex dashboard.

Physician impact (physicianImpact): A physician on the Nursing Home side has no control to remove a resident, so those removals are never logged, and no end-of-pilot task-reminder survey ever reaches them. Vikram, reading the doc, follows a link that goes nowhere for the patient-list fields and finds aiCallLog columns such as the `ok` boolean that the doc never explains. / A Nursing Home physician has no way in the app to remove a resident from their list, so Nursing Home removals are never logged, and no end-of-pilot task-reminder survey is ever shown. Vikram will hit a dead link for the patient-activity fields and will see aiCallLog columns like `ok` and `parseStatus` that the doc never explains.

Review verdict (verdict): fail

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
